cinderImp.name: Cinder Imp
cinderImp.notes: Emberfall's fodder: quick, flimsy, swarms the coast. Level 1.

ashHound.name: Ash Hound
ashHound.notes: A grey-furred hunter of the ash fields: fast, bites hard. Levels 1-2.

emberCaster.name: Ember Caster
emberCaster.notes: A robed cultist who keeps its distance and lobs slow fireballs. Level 2.

magmaBrute.name: Magma Brute
magmaBrute.notes: A hulking troll in ember-red breeches; slow, hits hard, barely flinches. Level 3.

obsidianWarden.name: Obsidian Warden
obsidianWarden.notes: The caldera's guardian: gilded plate over bone, a burning blade. Campaign 2's boss, level 4.

castaway.name: Castaway
lines: You're awake! The storm threw us both onto this cursed shore.
The Keeper by the fire knows this land. Talk to them first.

emberbloom.name: Emberbloom
notes: An emberbloom, its petals glowing like coals. It is hot, but it does not burn you.
Another emberbloom. Ash settles on it and flares away in tiny sparks.

ember_trail.title: The Ember Trail

chapters.title: Ash and Ember
intro: So you made it through. Few do, these days.
I am {keeper}, keeper of this camp. A fire under the land is waking, and everything that crawls out of the wild is angry about it.
Help me hold {r1}, and I will tell you why the ground burns.

chapters.title: The Burning Heart
intro: What I feared is true: the guardian of {r2} has woken, and it is calling the fire to itself.
Take {r1~r2.way}. If it is not stopped, this land goes under, and the two of us with it.

quests.learned: The {r1.common.lower} are not hunting: they are fleeing something deeper in.
fieldNote: The last one scrambles off, glancing back the way it came rather than at you.
quests.title: Hold the Camp
offer: The {r1.common.lower} are thick around the camp today. Drive off five of them before they get into the stores.
done: Good. The camp is ours again, for now.
They were running, you know. Not attacking. Something frightens them.

quests.learned: The {r1.site.lower} only open when the fire rises close under the ground.
fieldNote: Four of them, all burning brighter than they should. Even the ground is warm under your feet.
quests.title: Read the Signs
quests.hint: {r1.site.plural} grow all over {r1}: look by its edges.
offer: The {r1.site.lower} tell the land's mood. Touch four of them and tell me how they burn.
done: Brighter than they should be. Much brighter.
Take this draught; you will need it where you are going next.

quests.learned: The {r1.hunter.lower} hunt in the open now; the woods are too hot for them.
fieldNote: The fourth one falls. Its hide is singed down to the skin.
quests.title: Clear the Road
quests.hint: {r1.hunter.plural} roam the open ground of {r1}. They see you before you see them.
offer: Before you go on, clear the {r1.hunter.lower} from the road. Four of them.
done: The road is clear. Rest, and then take {r1~r2.way}.

quests.learned: The {r2.ranged.lower} are feeding the fire, ember by ember, for their guardian.
fieldNote: The last one's fire gutters out. The air cools, just a little.
quests.title: Quench the Tenders
quests.hint: {r2.ranged.plural} keep to {r2}: take {r1~r2.way}. Close in fast: they strike from afar.
offer: Things in {r2} are feeding the fire. Stop four of the {r2.ranged.lower}, and the guardian goes hungry.
remind: Four {r2.ranged.lower}, in {r2}. Do not let them keep their distance.
done: The land is quieter already. One thing remains, and it is the hardest.

quests.learned: The {r2.boss} was a keeper once, before the fire took its mind.
fieldNote: The {r2.boss} kneels, and its fire cools to black. Far away, the ground stops trembling.
quests.title: The Guardian
offer: The guardian waits in {r2}. It was a keeper like me, once. Free it.
done: It is done. I felt the land sigh.
Take this blade, forged here long ago. It is yours by right now.

epilogue: The fire sleeps again, and the land is calm for the first time in a year.
Stay as long as you like. This camp is yours as much as mine.

lore.way: the ash trail that climbs north from The Cinder Coast into The Ember Caldera

sign.cinder_coast: Ash from The Ember Caldera falls on the camp like grey snow, and it is warm.
sign.ember_caldera: Far below, the smoke of the camp on The Cinder Coast rises thin and blue.
